key.description: Ticket key (e.g. `TICKET-3`). Used by `ticket`, `result`, `edit`. Defaults to the agent's current ticket. Ignored by `create`, `list`.

aql.description: For `list`: which tickets to answer with, in AQL. Fields are `key`, `label`, `status`, `agent`, `parent`, `task`, `result`. Operators are `=`, `!=`, `IN (a, b)`, `NOT IN (a, b)`, `IS EMPTY`, `IS NOT EMPTY`, and on `task` and `result` the case-insensitive `~` and `!~`. Combine terms with `AND`, `OR`, `NOT`, and parentheses. A lone word is the label; a lone `TICKET-N` is that ticket. Status is one of `Todo`, `InProgress`, `Finished`, `Failed`. Leave out to answer with every ticket.

label.description: For `create` or `edit` (optional): the ticket's label scope, which decides who picks it up: every agent serving that label may claim it. A ticket carries at most one label, and on `edit` the new one replaces the current one.

task.description: For `create` (required) or `edit` (optional): the task body, any JSON value (string, object, array, scalar).

examples.aql: task ~ "retry budget" AND agent IS EMPTY

examples.task: Check the retry budget on the upload path.
examples.label: review
